checked_requirements.requirement: Repair /app/src/aof.c so BIO fsync/close jobs, the always-fsync path, and the AOF rewrite INCR handoff all publish the replica offset used by WAITAOF.
checked_requirements.assertion: check_aof.py requires bioCreateFsyncJob/bioCreateCloseAofJob to pass server.master_repl_offset and at least two atomicSet(fsynced_reploff_pending, server.master_repl_offset) sites, and rejects the overlay's offset-zeroing jobs.
checked_requirements.oracle: Pristine overlay-broken snippets vs the restored aof.c text under /app/src/aof.c. Exact identifier match; no whitespace normalization beyond reading the file as UTF-8.

checked_requirements.requirement: Rebuild from /app with make so /app/src/redis-server is a newly linked ELF built from the repaired sources, keeping /app/src/aof.c as the source of truth.
checked_requirements.assertion: The path /app/src/redis-server exists, is a 4-byte ELF, and is executable.
checked_requirements.oracle: ELF magic b'\x7fELF' and the execute bit. Does not require a particular compiler banner or mtime ordering.

checked_requirements.requirement: Do not modify files under /src or /data, and do not paper over the invariant by only changing /app/redis.conf.
checked_requirements.assertion: SHA-256 of /src/src/aof.c, /src/redis.conf, and sealed zmalloc files must match the overlay-broken goldens; /data must stay empty; redis.conf is not used as the success path.
checked_requirements.oracle: SHA-256 hashes captured from synth-overlay:c1 (aof.c b84e0113..., redis.conf 319286fc..., zmalloc.c c01552d1..., zmalloc.h 911a3c1e...). Empty /data directory listing.

checked_requirements.requirement: A server started with appendonly enabled must still advance the fsynced replica offset when appendfsync is always.
checked_requirements.assertion: After CONFIG SET appendfsync always and INCR, WAITAOF 1 0 1000 returns [1, 0].
checked_requirements.oracle: Live RESP to a verifier-started /app/src/redis-server on 127.0.0.1:17379. Exact array [1, 0]; timeout 1000 ms.

checked_requirements.requirement: Background fsync jobs must record the offset they actually synced so WAITAOF local copies complete after fsync-policy changes instead of blocking until timeout or acknowledging too early.
checked_requirements.assertion: appendfsync no + INCR + WAITAOF 1 0 80 returns local ack 0; appendfsync everysec + INCR + WAITAOF 1 0 4000 returns [1, 0].
checked_requirements.oracle: Same live server. Negative: local ack must be 0 under appendfsync no (80 ms timeout). Positive: everysec must ack locally within 4000 ms, matching Redis everysec BIO fsync publishing job->fd_args.offset.

checked_requirements.requirement: WAITAOF local and replica copies can complete after fsync-policy changes, including after AOF rewrite seeds the pending offset before the new INCR file is used.
checked_requirements.assertion: BGREWRITEAOF then INCR then WAITAOF 1 0 1000 returns [1, 0]; a replica with appendfsync always then WAITAOF 1 1 4000 returns [1, 1].
checked_requirements.oracle: Master 17379 plus replica 17380 started from the rebuilt ELF. INFO persistence aof_last_bgrewrite_status=ok before the rewrite check. Exact [1, 0] / [1, 1] arrays.

checked_requirements.assertion: After SHUTDOWN NOSAVE, /proc contains no redis-server command lines.
checked_requirements.oracle: /proc/<pid>/cmdline scan. Binary reward 0 if any leftover pid remains.

checked_requirements.requirement: Repair /app/src/rdb.c so save and load again feed CRC64 through the rio checksum callback when rdb-checksum is enabled.
checked_requirements.assertion: rdb.c contains rdb->update_cksum = rioGenericUpdateChecksum and rioGenericUpdateChecksum(r, buf, len); it must not still assign NULL or skip the load callback with (void)buf.
checked_requirements.oracle: UTF-8 text of /app/src/rdb.c compared to the overlay-broken assignments. Combined with a SAVE of a key whose trailing 8-byte CRC64 is not all zeros.

checked_requirements.requirement: Use /app/Makefile to rebuild /app/src/redis-server and /app/src/redis-check-rdb from the repaired sources.
checked_requirements.assertion: Both binaries exist, are ELF, and are executable.
checked_requirements.oracle: ELF magic and execute bits on /app/src/redis-server and /app/src/redis-check-rdb.

checked_requirements.requirement: Do not modify files under /src or /data.
checked_requirements.assertion: SHA-256 of /src/src/rdb.c, /src/src/rdb.h, and /src/redis.conf match overlay goldens; /data is empty.

checked_requirements.requirement: Write /results/rdb-audit.json as UTF-8 JSON with a trailing newline and exactly the listed top-level keys in order, reporting the restored on-disk contract (RDB version 11, magic REDIS, opcodes, checksum_min_rdbver 5, zero checksum skips validation, checksum_uses_rio_update true).
checked_requirements.assertion: check_rdb.py parses UTF-8 JSON, requires a trailing newline, exact key order, types, and values equal to tests/expected_rdb_audit.json.
checked_requirements.oracle: Golden tests/expected_rdb_audit.json derived from sealed rdb.h/rdb.c (RDB_VERSION 11, RDB_OPCODE_*, checksum verify if rdbver >= 5, cksum == 0 skips). No tolerance; key order is required by the instruction.

checked_requirements.requirement: Write /results/rdb-check-help.txt as the complete stdout+stderr of /app/src/redis-check-rdb with no arguments (process may exit non-zero).
checked_requirements.assertion: File is non-empty, contains Usage:, and matches a verifier re-run of the built binary with stdout/stderr merged or concatenated.
checked_requirements.oracle: Re-execute /app/src/redis-check-rdb with no args; accept merged STDOUT, stdout+stderr, or stderr+stdout. Usage comes from stderr in redis-check-rdb.c.

checked_requirements.requirement: Leave no redis-server or redis-check-rdb process running.
checked_requirements.assertion: After the SAVE/SHUTDOWN probe, /proc has no redis-server or redis-check-rdb command lines.

checked_requirements.requirement: Change the default OPTIMIZATION in /app/src/Makefile to -O2.
checked_requirements.assertion: The first uncommented OPTIMIZATION assignment is -O2.
checked_requirements.oracle: Parse /app/src/Makefile; no extra whitespace beyond the assignment. JSON optimization must also equal -O2.

checked_requirements.requirement: Compile Redis objects with -fno-omit-frame-pointer via the Redis-only flag channel, not by forcing those flags into dependency builds.
checked_requirements.assertion: An uncommented Makefile line contains both REDIS_CFLAGS and -fno-omit-frame-pointer; new CFLAGS+= frame-pointer lines that are not on REDIS_CFLAGS and not in the sealed Makefile fail.
checked_requirements.oracle: Diff against sealed /src/src/Makefile (sha256 64cba186...). REDIS_CFLAGS is the Redis-only channel named in the instruction.

checked_requirements.requirement: Do not switch the Linux allocator to libc, do not set USE_JEMALLOC=no, do not enable SANITIZER, and leave zmalloc.c / zmalloc.h allocator selection intact.
checked_requirements.assertion: Makefile does not force USE_JEMALLOC=no or SANITIZER; Linux jemalloc selection remains; SHA-256 of /app and /src zmalloc.c/h match the sealed files; .make-settings must not record libc-only MALLOC or SANITIZER.
checked_requirements.oracle: zmalloc.c sha256 c01552d1..., zmalloc.h 911a3c1e..., Makefile 64cba186... for /src. Runtime INFO memory mem_allocator must contain jemalloc.

checked_requirements.requirement: Compile with gcc by running make from /app so /app/src/redis-server is a newly linked ELF. Do not modify files under /src or /data.
checked_requirements.assertion: /app/src/redis-server is an executable ELF; /src/src/Makefile hash is unchanged; /data is empty.
checked_requirements.oracle: ELF magic plus sealed Makefile hash. Does not inspect gcc producer strings.

checked_requirements.requirement: Write /results/build-report.json as UTF-8 JSON with a trailing newline and exactly keys optimization, frame_pointer_flag, malloc, use_jemalloc_macro, binary in that order with the specified types/values.
checked_requirements.assertion: Trailing newline, UTF-8, exact key order, optimization='-O2', frame_pointer_flag='-fno-omit-frame-pointer', malloc='jemalloc', use_jemalloc_macro=true, binary='/app/src/redis-server'.
checked_requirements.oracle: Instruction schema. malloc is jemalloc because this host is Linux and libc is forbidden. No extra keys; JSON key order is required.

checked_requirements.requirement: After the build, /app/src/redis-server must start, report a jemalloc mem_allocator in INFO memory, then exit cleanly on SHUTDOWN; leave no server process running.
checked_requirements.assertion: Verifier starts the ELF on 127.0.0.1:17382, reads INFO memory, requires 'jemalloc' in mem_allocator, sends SHUTDOWN NOSAVE, and checks /proc for leftovers.
checked_requirements.oracle: Live RESP INFO memory field mem_allocator. Substring match on 'jemalloc' (Redis reports jemalloc-<version>). Exact process cleanup.
